samples.question: The blue-framed square panel below holds one solid triangle cut into six vertical columns. Every column has been slid up or down and wrapped around the panel edges by a random distance; each column carries one small magenta square sitting at a fixed reference height before the slide. Undo the declared per-column slides by moving each column so its magenta square returns to that fixed reference height (bottom area), then reassemble the triangle. Does the reconstructed triangle point up (A) or down (B)? Answer A or B.
